Remaining: lasagna, pizza, refrigerator. The best question separates one item from the other two, and a 1/2 split is the most any question can do with three items.

"Can you eat it?" separates the refrigerator from lasagna and pizza. "Does it need electricity?" would isolate the refrigerator too. "Is it bigger than a breadbox?" would put the refrigerator on one side, but a pizza could arguably go either way. "Is it flat?" would isolate pizza, though lasagna is arguably flat too, so that answer is ambiguous.

"Can you eat it?" is clean.
